The internet today is mostly insecure, but we don't have any feedback mechanism make us feel the insecurity. For many this generates complacency with the current system of government surveillance. If you want to really get a sense of how insecure the web is, I've found that this HTTPS only challenge is a great way to help yourself feel it. Here's how the challenge works:

  1. Download the EFF's HTTPS Everywhere extension for Chrome or Firefox.

  2. Turn on "Block all HTTP requests". Whenever you click on a link that does not support HTTPS, you will get a blank page. Whenever you see this page, remind yourself that the site was blocked because it is insecure. You just shut your blinds on a malicious snooper standing outside your window.

  3. Use Tor Browser to access any website that does not support HTTPS that you really need to access.

  4. If the website is blocked or unusable in Tor Browser, email the site administrator asking them to support HTTPS. After emailing the administrator, you can momentarily turn off "Block all HTTP requests" or add that site to an exception list.

Do this for an entire week. Because the challenge is set up to make it inconvenient to access insecure sites, you will learn to value HTTPS sites more and more over time.

Bonus challenges:

  • Hard mode. Your Tor Browser must be set to high security on the security slider.
  • Harder mode. Hard mode + refuse to access sites that do not support HTTPS.
  • Activist mode. Harder mode + Tor Browser is the only allowed browser.
  • Pro activist mode. Activist mode + you are running TAILS from a usb stick as your operating system.

"... we’ve ensured that you will never have to compete with other players for resources or objectives"

I must say, this is my absolute favorite thing about GW2. Coming from three years of WoW, it was quite a refreshing change, and the positive impact it has on the community in general is pretty obvious.

I remember camping rare mobs for hours and then some random dude finds it and kills it without hesitating. I LOVE this feature in gw2 that you never have to compete with other players. Instead of competing - cooperation.
Oh, I certainly don't miss camping for random spawns, just an artificial time sink. I much prefer the way GW2 has all the bosses on a regular schedule.

I also think this is something that a lot of players that haven't ventured far outside of the Guild Wars universe tend to take for granted - myself included. We lack the understanding of just how frustrating it can be to play with other players in other games that are supposed to be centered around interaction with other players.

Other players showing up is not the blessing it is in Guild Wars 2, it's a curse and it leads to a lot of animosity towards one another. Guild Wars 2 might not have every means of interaction you desire, it might be lacking in some areas - but we should always keep in mind that, at least we're playing a game where it has been made fun to play with and in the vicinity of other players rather than crossing your fingers and hoping they don't show up before the mob spawns.
